inspection_note: Whole page then halves read. All words, accents and formulas checked in enlarged blocks, all C/H differences and C doubts separately examined. Number and marginal instruction rotated upright. Underlines, deletion levels, two inserted maps and every Greek or alphabet-deciding capital reviewed from ink. Lowercase la, unaccented Etant and the surviving d’invariant after replacement by poids are retained. No context or mathematical check.

audits.observations: Root ordered second reading: whole image and both actual supplied halves viewed before the image-first receipt and text opening; 47 fresh crops personally inspected, including upright manuscript21 and the rotated margin note. All agreed and differing prose, accents, numbers, formulas, deletions, insertions, underlines and margin elements checked. Three physical word divisions are restored. The lemma first two underline endings exclude un and Pour que. Handwritten heading numbers are explicitly tagged and inventoried, without a macro-only collation row. Every repeated raised homomorphism oval is qualified in place. The deleted p is now placed on the arrow shaft directly below its replacement. The B-to-C arrow retains its detached upper-wing retracing. The circled instruction has its short upper gap restored, and the isolated angular mark beside21 is drawn. The old map initial now gives varphi before chi from its rounded bowl and descender; the entire map stays qualified. The overworked character symbol is qualified consistently in both the action formula and inserted map. The remaining uncertain reference, first vector functor, lower margin word and cancelled formula/character remain unresolved. The old Le fait que, mnet order with transposition loop, lower-case la, unaccented Etant, original 8.2 3 reference, baseline composition o, plain underlined G_m,k, corrected est, all cancellations and exclamation were retained from the ink. Manuscript21 and archive52 remain distinct. Nine doubt entries remain. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
